AI & Marketing Concepts

Learning Architect

A professional who designs learning or experience environments rather than simply transmitting information.

Explanation

The Learning Architect concept originated from education initiatives in Estonia and Singapore, redefining teachers as designers of learning experiences rather than content deliverers. The same logic applies to marketing, where leaders must become Marketing Architects designing end-to-end customer experiences. Success depends on intentional, empathetic design rather than information transmission. This shift reflects broader MMA Global initiatives in CAP and MMGF frameworks.

Usage context / examples

A learning architect curates an environment where learners construct knowledge through guided discovery. Similarly, a marketing architect orchestrates touchpoints that guide customers through personalized, adaptive journeys.

Related terms

CAP (Consortium for AI Personalization), MMGF (Movable Middles Growth Framework)
